pages.text: $(l)Mystery Energy$() fuels the Divine equipment. You start with 100.$(br2)Every kill adds 10 to both your energy and its maximum, and it refills to the maximum at the start of each in-game day. It is kept on death.

Divine Punishment's bonus true damage and Divine Blessing's full damage block each cost 1000.$(br2)That is expensive, but Divine Blessing can block even command damage. The HUD sits in the bottom-left corner and turns red when you are low.
